concept.title: Understanding DITA's layered hierarchy

conbody.p: The hierarchical structure of DITA is rooted in XML, where content is organized as a tree of nested elements and referenced components. In DITA, hierarchy operates at multiple levels: within elements, within topics, and across maps. Together, these layers create a system where content is both modular and contextually aware.
